name: psono
description: Psono server: the backend of the self-hosted Psono password manager for teams. Official image psono/psono-server. The Psono browser extensions, apps and web client connect to it. This container has no web UI of its own: the WebUI button opens /info/, which shows the server version when it runs. Before the first start: a PostgreSQL database and settings.yaml in the config folder (appdata/psono/settings.yaml). The README has the steps. Database migrations run automatically at every start. For real use, put it behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS.

ports.name: API port
ports.description: Psono server API. Clients and your reverse proxy connect here.
